blocks.text: SYDNEY — Former New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern has taken up a post at a major Australian university. Ms Ardern, who was her home country’s leader from 2017 to 2023, will soon begin guest-lecturing, running masterclasses and mentoring students and researchers at the University of Sydney. She has been appointed a professor of practice – a part-time role for people with extensive leadership experience outside of academia – in the school of public health. Her work will focus on areas including empathetic leadership, social cohesion and civic trust. READ: New Zealand’s ex-PM Jacinta Ardern now based in Australia – media […]...
